clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands, Sida's Bag lies swallowed in an ooze near Ironbeard's Tomb. Sida, a resident of Menethil Harbor, fled after throwing her satchel at one of the slimes during her weekly visit; the bag and its contents must be recovered from the acidic creatures.

Sida visits Ironbeard's Tomb near Dun Modr each week. Dreadful, dripping oozes ambushed her there, and panic drove her to fling her satchel at one of them. The ooze absorbed the bag into its body. The distraction gave Sida time to escape alive and return to Menethil Harbor, while her possessions remained trapped inside an unknown slime.

The oozes around Ironbeard's Tomb range from crimson to monstrous, and look much alike. Sida's Bag can be found by cutting down the marsh slimes until the swallowed satchel emerges intact. Acidic muck has soaked the durable sack, but its contents remain preserved. Sida reclaims her belongings, then discards the ruined, slime-coated exterior and offers the washed-out container to whoever braved the marsh on her behalf.
